businesses.business: senior housing and healthcare real estate investment trust

offering_description.value: Owns senior housing and skilled nursing properties and leases them to or partners with third-party operators. Also provides mortgage and other financing to senior care operators. Earns rent and interest from long-term leases and loans.

primary_services.value: leasing of senior housing properties; mortgage lending; property management through operator partnerships

customer_segment.value: B2B: senior housing and skilled nursing operators

end_markets.value: senior housing; assisted living and memory care; skilled nursing; healthcare real estate

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: rent from triple-net leases and operating (RIDEA) senior housing properties; interest or premiums: interest income from mortgage loans and other financing to operators
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; interest or premiums

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns senior care properties acquired or developed, leased to operators or run via third-party managers; financial intermediary: lends mortgage and mezzanine financing to senior care operators

geography_served.value: US national: Senior care properties across many US states

specialization.value: related lines: senior housing, skilled nursing, and related mortgage financing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct lease and loan relationships with operators

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: REIT tax rules, tenants face Medicare/Medicaid and state licensing regulation affecting rent coverage
